pages.title: The Steady-State Approximation
pages.text: $(thing)The Steady-State Approximation$()$(br2)An enzyme's middle step is made as fast as it is used up: set its rate of change to zero, and the algebra falls out.

$(thing)Insight$(): 80$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Enzyme Kinetics.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 1 Engineered Enzyme.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): An enzyme catches its substrate at a rate a, lets it go at b and turns it over at c. Write the substrate level K at which it runs at half speed.
